description: This Java source file defines the class 'ModifyFeaturesResponse', which represents the response to a 'ModifyFeatures' command in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances based on HTTP statuses, parsing from JSON, and accessing response data such as the affected Thing ID and created features. The class is annotated as immutable and JSON-serializable, with functionality for JSON payload integration.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesResponse
classes.description: Response object for a modify features command, including status, associated thing ID, created features, and JSON serialization/deserialization logic.
